in.scope: proposed ADDRESSES: whether more optimisation pressure on debaters keeps judge accuracy high, for LLM debaters on QuALITY with an LLM judge

text: The authors state that strong dishonest-debater strategies that break debate at the Nash equilibrium may exist which their human debaters did not find or gave up on too easily, so the high judge accuracy may partly reflect dishonest-debater mistakes. Addressing whether debate works in the limit will require more optimization pressure on debaters, which may only be practical with AI systems capable of debating well.
title: Undiscovered dishonest strategies could break debate at Nash equilibrium
